topic_title: Traffic Laws as the Foundation for Decisions
prompt: What is the primary legal meaning and required driver response when approaching a yellow diamond-shaped road sign?

options.text: Regulatory mandate — come to an immediate halt and yield to crossing vehicles
Interstate route confirmation — maintain cruising speed along designated freeway lanes
Construction detour restriction — shift immediately into the far right lane only
Warning of hazards ahead — slow down and prepare for changing road conditions
